title: random pack
description: A resource pack with silly changes like totems with red eyes or a smiling sun in the sky
body:
this resource pack is where I plan to test making a resource pack, it currently has:

- a redesign of the sun to make it a smiling sun (*^▽^*)
- redesign of the end dimension sky to make it smoother and easier
- a redesign of the sheep and chicken face to a more blank and creepy design
- a redesign of the totem of undying's green eyes to make them red

there's no theme to the changes so expect the unexpected ╰(*°▽°*)╯
